problem_restatement.input: The preregistered BTC fifteen-minute trend-pullback reacceleration candidate failed every validation and pseudo-holdout acceptance check.
problem_restatement.output: Separate entry-edge failure, cost drag, realized payoff requirements, actual-exit path behavior, and early forward timing before choosing another hypothesis.
problem_restatement.success_criterion: Reproduce all 147 standalone nominal candidate trades from exact registered sources, retain causal entry diagnostics and exact minute paths, and issue no threshold, subgroup, retuning, or live recommendation.

bias_disclosure.inference_boundary: The attribution can diagnose the rejected mechanism and motivate a materially distinct future hypothesis. It cannot validate a filter or rescue this candidate.

mechanism_attribution.costs_only_diagnosis: falsified because aggregate gross PnL was already negative before fees and funding
mechanism_attribution.payoff_adequacy: failed because the 46.94% realized win rate was below the 57.19% after-cost break-even rate

entry_context_difference.interpretation: Stopped entries were more extended on average, but this opened post-hoc difference does not validate an EMA-gap filter.

decision.reason: The frozen entry/payoff combination lacked gross edge, required a materially higher win rate than it achieved, and stopped paths were adverse early and persistently.

failure_modes_and_falsifiers: A changed registered source hash, non-identical reproduction, missing exact minute horizon, or trade-count mismatch invalidates the artifact.
Exact mark, BBO, or latency replay materially reversing gross path ordering would update the mechanism interpretation, although not the frozen bar-replay rejection without a new contract.
Independent prospectively frozen evidence would be required to validate any context or timing distinction observed here.

single_highest_value_next_action.action: Perform a source-bound prior-art and historical disposition audit of the existing BTC Hulk robust-v3 raw long mechanism before deciding whether a distinct long-side hypothesis is eligible for preregistration.
single_highest_value_next_action.why: The live ledger recorded a robust-v3 long-side squeeze-release candidate that was excluded solely by short-only authority, while the rejected pullback family should not be threshold-tuned.
constraints: Do not restore unchanged Hulk v2 long authority.
Do not select from the recent missed rally alone.
Stop if robust-v3 long is merely a nearby retuning of already rejected evidence or lacks chronological after-cost support.
No live routing or configuration change without a separate validated proposal and explicit approval.

independent_reproduction.verification: Observation sidecars are byte-identical and canonical reports are identical after excluding generated_at_utc.
